maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new equipment: mowers, snow plows, underground construction machines, irrigation, via dealers; aftermarket parts are a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are golf courses, landscape contractors, homeowners, rental companies; government and schools are only a minor customer group.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through product innovation and sales across its brands; Ditch Witch, Exmark and others were occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Customers can buy mowers and equipment from competitors like Deere; switching means dealer and fleet changes, not regulatory or critical downtime.
